Here is the mental model, plus the 6 myths that fail interviews. Save it for your next interview. 📌

Inside:
1. A queue as a slot-ownership protocol
2. SPSC, MPSC, SPMC, MPMC in one table
3. Full vs empty with monotonic indices
4. The two acquire/release edges of an SPSC ring
5. Full-queue policies and what they lose
6. Six myths, busted (slides 8-9)

Which myth did you believe? Comment the slide number.
